SitePhoto.title: SitePhoto
SitePhoto.description: Custom photograph uploaded by a verified MDA administrator for a specific website slot (hero, about, teacher, or gallery).

slotId.description: Unique identifier for the photo slot matching the document ID.

dataUrl.description: Compressed base64 JPEG/PNG/WebP data URI stored below the 750KB safety threshold.

isPublic.description: Explicit visibility flag enforced by Firestore list rules.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last updated this photo.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator directory record managed out-of-band.

/site_photos/{slotId}.description: Publicly readable website photos writable strictly by verified MDA administrators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Admin role registry; strictly read-only for the authenticated admin and closed to client writes.
